compartment.title: Update Dockerfile for ONNX build
compartment.p1: Assistant updated the `Dockerfile` to implement the new ORT configuration and attempted a full project build with the ONNX feature enabled. The initial build failed because the `esaxx-rs` crate required `g++` to be present in the build environment. The assistant updated the `Dockerfile` to include `g++` and triggered a rebuild to verify the fix.
compartment.p2: Updated `Dockerfile` and tested the project build with the ONNX feature. Resolved a build failure by adding `g++` to the image to satisfy `esaxx-rs` dependencies.
compartment.p3: Updated `Dockerfile` and resolved `g++` dependency for `esaxx-rs` during ONNX build.
